title: OP ANIMATION CHANGER
features:
LIQUID HUB
ANIMATION CHANGER
Welcome to our script, where you can change your Roblox Animation freely. We've tested the script on some Roblox games and it did work well.

The script will have a key system, but only 1 checkpoint (linkvertise)

The current animation that are on the scripts are:

- Default

- Zombie

- Ninja

- Robot

- Vampire

- Werewolf

- Cartoony

- Toy

- Stylish

More soon!

If you have any suggestions or want to add your favorite animation, just simply join to our discord community. But you can also suggest through the script, we've added a function for that so we can know/be informed if users have requests or new animation idea.

Joining to our discord community will be a big big support for us. Thank you!
